claude.sample_unit: LLM-generated patient education materials (3 LLMs, 3 prompts; 20 existing online resources rewritten)

links.outcome: Readability (SMOG, FKGL) of LLM patient education materials with explicit 6th-grade prompt versus general understandability prompt
links.effect: Prompt B (6th-grade SMOG) responses were more readable than Prompt A for all 3 LLMs (P ≤ .001); ChatGPT-4 most readable.
links.quote: Prompt B responses were more readable than Prompt A responses for all 3 LLM (P ≤ .001).

links.outcome: Whether LLM rewrites of existing online materials achieved 6th-grade reading level
links.effect: Prompt C rewrites consistently reduced mean SMOG and FKGL, but only ChatGPT-4 achieved the 6th-grade level (SMOG 4.8 ± 0.8, FKGL 3.7 ± 1.9).
links.quote: Although Prompt C responses showed consistent reduction of mean SMOG and FKGL scores, only ChatGPT-4 achieved the specified 6th-grade reading level (4.8 ± 0.8 and 3.7 ± 1.9, respectively).

unlisted_practices: Prompting LLMs with explicit readability-formula targets (SMOG 6th-grade) to generate patient education materials

openai.sample_unit: online childhood glaucoma resources rewritten by each LLM; prompt-generated PEMs also evaluated

links.effect: Prompt B was more readable (P ≤ .001); for Prompt C, only ChatGPT-4 achieved 6th-grade level (SMOG 4.8 ± 0.8; FKGL 3.7 ± 1.9).
links.quote: Although Prompt C responses showed consistent reduction of mean SMOG and FKGL scores, only ChatGPT-4 achieved the specified 6th-grade reading level (4.8 ± 0.8 and 3.7 ± 1.9, respectively).

links.outcome: Accuracy and misinformation in LLM-generated PEMs
links.effect: All 3 LLMs had Misinformation score = 1, with DISCERN ≥4 and ≥70% PEMAT understandability.
links.quote: All 3 LLMs generated PEMs that were of high quality, understandability, and accuracy (DISCERN ≥4, ≥70% PEMAT understandability, Misinformation score = 1).

links.outcome: reading level of rewritten patient education materials
links.effect: ChatGPT-4 achieved 6th-grade level (SMOG 4.8 ± 0.8, FKGL 3.7 ± 1.9), while ChatGPT-3.5 and Bard did not
links.quote: Although Prompt C responses showed consistent reduction of mean SMOG and FKGL scores, only ChatGPT-4 achieved the specified 6th-grade reading level (4.8 ± 0.8 and 3.7 ± 1.9, respectively).
